name: tr_ibaka
caption:
IF SERGE HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🦜 Chatot: can learn and speak human words. Serge speaks 4: Lingala, French, English and Spanish
🧱 Mr. Mime: its fingertips harden the air into a real wall. Led the NBA in blocks twice
🗿 Golurk: its ability is No Guard, every attack lands. Started 14-for-14 and dropped 34 on the Lakers in 2018
🍲 Delibird: carries food all day long and shares it. Chef Serge fed his teammates on How Hungry Are You?
✂️ Furfrou: nobles competed to trim its fur into the most exquisite style. On Vanity Fair's Best Dressed List in 2019
🐉 Kommo-o: when it howls after a win, its comrades celebrate all around. Traded to us in 2017, a champion in 2019

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Serge Ibaka had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF SERGE IBAKA HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Chatot. It can learn and speak human words. Serge speaks four languages: Lingala, French, English and Spanish.
beats.dlg: IT LEARNS HUMAN WORDS.|SERGE SPEAKS 4 LANGUAGES

beats.vo: Mister Mime. Its fingertips harden the air into an actual wall. Serge led the whole league in blocks, twice.
beats.dlg: IT TURNS AIR INTO A WALL.|LED THE NBA IN BLOCKS 2X

beats.vo: Golurk. Its ability is No Guard: every attack lands. November twenty eighteen, Serge starts fourteen for fourteen, and finishes with thirty-four.
beats.dlg: ITS ABILITY: NO GUARD.|14-FOR-14 START, 34 PTS!

beats.vo: Delibird. It carries food all day long and shares it. Serge is a chef, too: on his show How Hungry Are You, he fed his teammates.
beats.dlg: IT CARRIES FOOD TO SHARE.|CHEF SERGE FED THE TEAM

beats.vo: Furfrou. Nobles once competed to trim its fur into the most exquisite style. In twenty nineteen, Vanity Fair put Serge on its Best Dressed List.
beats.dlg: STYLED FOR THE NOBLES.|VANITY FAIR'S BEST DRESSED

beats.vo: And the ace. Kommo-oh. When it howls after a win, its comrades celebrate all around it. We traded Terrence Ross for Serge in twenty seventeen. Twenty nineteen: champions.
That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Ibaka speaks four (4) languages: Lingala, French, English and Spanish; twice (2X) led the NBA in blocks (2012, 2013); on 4 November 2018 he made his first 14 shots (14 of 14) on the way to a career-high 34 points vs the Lakers; a chef on his YouTube series How Hungry Are You?, as Mafuzzy Chef, serving his teammates; named to Vanity Fair's Best Dressed List in 2019; traded to the Raptors on 14 February 2017 for Terrence Ross; NBA champion 2019 with the Raptors
